name: Captured Mountaineer
summary: In Brill, a captured Ironforge Mountaineer is held beneath the Gallows' End Tavern. The Forsaken keep him bound for the Royal Apothecary Society's experiments.

sections.title: A Prisoner in the Cellar
sections.body: Beneath the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, an Ironforge Mountaineer is held far from Khaz Modan. While patrons drink above, the Royal Apothecary Society uses him to test its concoctions. Apothecary Johaan and his peers measure their developing plague against living Alliance bodies, testing how swiftly and painfully their toxins kill.

faq.answer: He is an Alliance scout from Ironforge, now held by the Forsaken in the Gallows' End Tavern basement in Brill.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken keeping him alive in the basement?
aliases: why is he in the tavern
what are they doing to the dwarf
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society keeps him alive as a test subject. Apothecaries such as Johaan give him experimental mixtures to study their effects on living dwarves.

faq.q: What happens to him during the tests?
aliases: what happens in a new plague
faq.answer: The apothecaries force him to swallow concoctions as they develop a new plague. The lethal mixture kills him, showing the toxin's progress.

faq.q: Who else interacts with him down here?
faq.answer: The Deathguard use the tavern cellar to hold captured mountaineers until they can be dealt with. Apothecaries also come there to conduct experiments.

angles.text: For a dwarf, seeing an Ironforge brother caged beneath a Forsaken tavern and subjected to alchemical trials shows the Forsaken's hostility toward the living.
For the Forsaken, living Alliance captives serve the Royal Apothecary Society's effort to perfect a plague against the Scourge and the living.
